question: Raghunandan walks 325 m towards the west to reach a cloth showroom. Then he turns to the right and walks 220 m straight to reach the fitness centre. Again, he turns to the right and walks for 200 m straight. Then, he turns to the right again and walks for 220 m. How far is he from the starting point?( All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
• Raghunandan walks 325 m towards the west to reach a cloth showroom.
 
• Then he turns to the right and walks 220 m straight to reach the fitness centre.
 
• Again, he turns to the right and walks for 200 m straight.
 
• Then, he turns to the right again and walks for 220 m.
